# Image fixtures

Deterministic test images, generated by `crates/scaleup-core/examples/make_fixtures.rs`:

```bash
cargo run -p scaleup-core --example make_fixtures
```

The generator uses a fixed-seed LCG, so a rerun is byte-identical; commit the images with the
generator whenever one changes.

| File | Size | Content | Exercises |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gradient_64x48.png` | 64×48 RGB | horizontal red, vertical green, constant blue gradient | smooth content, a single tile |
| `alpha_checker_32x32.png` | 32×32 RGBA | 4-px checkerboard with alpha 0 or 255 | alpha path (binary alpha must survive) |
| `tiny_3x2.png` | 3×2 RGB | six distinct pixels | images smaller than the input multiple, reflect padding |
| `photo_like_256x192.jpg` | 256×192 JPEG q85 | gradient plus noise | JPEG decode, multi-tile tiling with overlap |
| `odd_1001x733.png` | 1001×733 RGB | solid colour with a diagonal line | odd sizes, shifted last tile row/column, seams |
